```text
public System.Void .ctor(Microsoft.PowerPlatform.Dataverse.Client.ServiceClient client, System.String name, System.Int32 maxPoolSize = 10)
```

Creates a new connection source wrapping an existing ServiceClient.

- Parameter `client`: The authenticated ServiceClient to use as the seed for cloning. Must be ready (P:Microsoft.PowerPlatform.Dataverse.Client.ServiceClient.IsReady == true).
- Parameter `name`: Unique name for this connection source. Used for logging and tracking.
- Parameter `maxPoolSize`: Maximum number of pooled connections from this source. Default is 10.
